dailyValueTargetGroup.name: Adults and children 4 or more years of age

statements.notes: Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement for immune system health take 1 teaspoon per day. We do not recommend exceeding 2 teaspoons per day.
Storage: Store in a cool, dark place. Do not freeze or expose to moisture or heat above room temperature.
Warning: Consult your physician before use.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use Colloidal Silver if you are pregnant, nursing, or are under 18 years of age.
Discontinue use and consult your doctor immediately if any adverse reactions occur.
Do not use Colloidal Silver and operate heavy machinery until you know how it affects you.
Keep out of reach of children.
Do not exceed 2 teaspoons per day.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
